No key exists on this frame: no single column is unique and the full 15-column tuple repeats (52 excess rows), so no subset of columns can be a key. The keys pass records not_applicable ('0 single-column unique, 0 composite').

The standard-budget run on the main build (2026-11-03, schema 0.4) selects 62 findings, well under the report cap; the guard records the count so a widening selection is re-baselined deliberately.
